parsed.justification: Rationale A correctly identifies that the comment lacks explicit grounding in a specific part of the paper and recognizes the specificity of the issue raised. It applies the rubric reasonably by mapping to score 3, though the reasoning about 'weakly grounded but specific' could be more precise about whether the comment truly specifies what needs to be addressed. Rationale B incorrectly concludes the comment fails to meet criteria for a fully grounded comment without properly mapping to the scoring rubric's intermediate scores. It doesn't provide a specific score and mischaracterizes the comment as completely ungrounded when the rubric allows for partial scores (2-3) for comments that lack grounding but specify what needs to be addressed. Both rationales adequately handle unsupported claims.
